brands.name: Di Surfboards Hawaii

models.name: Maui Flyer
models.description: MF (Maui Flyer). 5'8" x 20.5" x 2.47", 29.6 L. EPS core, epoxy glassed, 5 FCS 2. Low rocker throughout the board. Single to a double concave through the tail. Carbon stripes top and bottom with carbon heel and toe stripes. Custom dimensions available from 5'6" to 6'0".

models.name: Alpha Fish
models.description: AF (Alpha Fish). 5'11" x 20.25" x 2.47", 31.12 L. PU core, polyurethane resin glassed, Futures thruster. Medium rocker throughout the board. Single to double concave through the tail. Custom dimensions available from 5'6" to 6'0".

models.name: Mini Longboard
models.description: 8'6" x 23.25" x 3.25", 73.2 L. PU core, polyester resin, sanded finish, five-fin Futures setup. Bottom contour: V bottom to double concave. Custom dimensions available from 8'0" to 8'5".

models.name: Progressive Longboard
models.description: 9'2" x 23" x 3.12", 78.9 L. PU core, polyester resin, sanded finish, 2+1 Futures setup. Bottom contour: nose concave, V bottom to double concave. Custom dimensions available from 9'0" to 9'5".
